object_description: four-finger comb structure with a central longitudinal hall
design_condition: The compact comb mass follows the existing industrial buildings, establishes a clear urban setting with proportioned outdoor spaces, and reserves a southwest open area and a coherent extension zone for later phases.

positive.statement: The urban planning concept produces a clear and convincing setting of the building mass.
The outdoor spaces are well proportioned and can be used in a variety of ways.
The continuation of public space is logical and convincing.
The comb solution creates good exposure conditions.
The building takes on the scale of the surrounding area and fits harmoniously into the urban context.
The overall appearance is convincing, and the identity-forming silhouette is effective.
The central access hall creates optimal orientation and opens up the audience-intensive rooms in an interesting way.
The upper floors are clearly structured and show great flexibility.
Future expansions can be optimally implemented.

negative.statement: The design of the outdoor spaces is not yet suitable for the location and users in all areas.
The equivalence of the two front facades and entrances is criticized because a hierarchy is missing.
The jumps of one and three floors appear oppressive, and the generosity is lost.
The daylight conditions in the halls are problematic.
The think tank works, but it is missing some soul.
